Lazy AWS

📌

Hey Everyone 👋 I live in the terminal. I write code in Neovim and use lazygit, lazydocker and other TUIs every day. But each time I had to work with AWS, I had to leave the terminal for the console or type long CLI commands just to answer simple questions. Which instances are running? What is in this bucket? Did that Lambda deploy? I wanted the lazygit feel for AWS too, so I built my own: Lazy AWS. What it does: - Browse EC2, ECS, ECR, S3 and Lambda in one terminal UI - Filter lists, see related resources and read the full JSON details - Run actions such as stopping an instance or uploading a file, always with a confirmation step Try it in 10 seconds: $ brew install capybara-brain346/tap/lazyaws $ lazyaws [...] Subscribe
